sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in a strong position and will be favored against struggling Alsager Town, who sit bottom with just 4 points and have won only once all season.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday in a fixture between two mid-table sides, with Stafford looking to keep pace with the leaders after their own recent loss. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash of teams near the top—both are in form after recent wins. The battle for automatic promotion spots intensifies with Wolverhampton Casuals at home to Wednesfield Community, though Wolves then face Brereton Social away on Wednesday evening, making it a testing midweek fixture for them. Bilston Town host Foley Meir in a match between mid-table teams, while Barnton welcome Shawbury United on Saturday; Shawbury are in dire form with six consecutive losses. Elsewhere, Market Drayton Town travel to face in-form New Mills, Crewe host Allscott Heath, and Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a battle between two struggling sides near the bottom. Brereton Social host Widnes Town on Saturday; Widnes remain pointless in the league with just 2 points and have conceded 23 goals in 7 games.
